name: qrasoi-monorepo
description: QRasoi SaaS Monorepo Orchestrator (Client, Server & Mobile)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "CLIENT,SERVER" -c "bgOrange.bold,bgBlue.bold" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mobile install
